facts.fact: ARCEP states that under the texts in force every SIM card sold must be linked to a Numero National d'Identification (NNI) issued by ANATS; no law or date of the rule is named.

TCD.note: Nothing on a number at birth.
Only says ANATS issues the NNI; nothing on operation or maintenance.
SIM linkage is not a public register keyed on the ID.
No system status, biometrics or certification stated.

facts.fact: ARCEP says SIM cards must be linked to an NNI issued by ANATS and that some are still sold pre-activated with no identity check, so operators Moov Africa and Airtel face possible sanctions for not verifying identities.
